history.sg_progress: The Administration is already working on the development and implementation of a system-wide flexible working arrangements module for the administration of all flexible work arrangement types defined in ST/SGB/2019/3, including telecommuting within and outside the duty station. This project has been under way since 2021; monitoring reports are part of the functional specifications of the project and will be accessible to all Secretariat entities for self-monitoring. Implementation of the solution is dependent on the outcome of production integration and user verification testing. Final testing and user preparation are now under way. Aligning Umoja with the policy requirements under ST/SGB/2019/3 took the Umoja system vendor two and a half years due to the complexity. The development took far longer than anticipated, thus delaying the implementation.
